gate_or_program: STA-01 ? Non-color Focus / Selection State Grammar
design_axis: shared-brand non-color focus / selection state-treatment logic
bounded_question: Can one restrained structural grammar distinguish default, keyboard focus, selected, focus+selected and disabled states across neutral APP-like and WEB-like carriers without depending on candidate color, motion, iconography, imagery, material, bespoke typography, semantic status meaning, product-specific vocabulary, or CLR-01?

authority.current_state_at_close: same logical closure commit as this packet; exact commit identity is supplied by Git history rather than self-referential content

excluded_variables: CLR-01 family colors and production palette

local_result.summary: Valid hosted mechanical preflight passed every F1-F4 family. Frozen Design Sol subjective falsification leaves exactly one provisional survivor: F2 Ring + Edge Witness.
rejections: F1 ? Conventional Ring + Fill: too generic
F3 ? Ring + Opposing Brackets: crop/edit-tool reading
F4 ? Weight + Depth: over-authoritative and physically semantic

judgment.design_sol_view: F2 is the only family that remains mechanically robust and visually restrained while adding a recognizable non-color structural selection cue without borrowing editing, physical-depth or generic fill conventions.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: No separate Director family choice was requested or inferred. This bounded in-lane provisional result advances under the standing clean-recursive-audit delegation and remains subject to later composition/whole-app synthesis.

mechanical: real Tab-key :focus-visible: 8/8 APP/WEB contexts per mode
visual: prototypes/sta-01/harness.html ? canonical human-viewable normal comparison surface
accessibility: focus and selection remain independent when combined
disabled controls are skipped by keyboard traversal and remain not-selected
no horizontal document overflow at 320 CSS px

requires: later composition/whole-app synthesis before production tokenization
CLR-01 remains parked until its separately authorized convergence reentry

known_integration_sensitivities: The edge witness must remain a secondary selection carrier once CLR-01 is reintroduced; color may reinforce it but must not replace it.
APP/WEB orientation adaptation must preserve one edge-witness grammar rather than become two unrelated decorative rules.
Later component geometry must not make the witness resemble a progress bar, navigation indicator, validation stripe or semantic status marker.
Real product semantics and focus management remain implementation/engineering truths independent of this visual packet.
explicit_non_authority: No production control-state token, semantic-state system, app/site implementation, final identity, CLR-01 adjudication or Phase-C convergence is authorized.
The exact grayscale fixture values and edge dimensions are experiment values, not production tokens.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: Normal-mode F1-F4 state rows; forced-colors is validation only.
